messages:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — final performance reviews are due this Friday (EOD 5pm PT). Two asks: 1) If you have any attachments/evidence (docs, links, customer logs), please upload them to the review form by Thursday 12pm PT so reviewers can see them ahead of calibration. 2) We still need a few volunteers for the calibration panel on Tuesday 10–11am PT (will be virtual). Reply here if you can join.

Alex Gomez: Got it. I'll upload my team's attachments by tomorrow morning.

Jordan Patel: Quick Q — we have one IC on LOA returning right at the deadline. Do they need a special exception or a deferal?

Maya Chen: Good Q @Jordan Patel — exceptions go through people-ops. If you anticipate missing the cutoff because of LOA or timezone constraints, DM me the case or add them to the "exceptions" tab on the tracker by Wed EOD. We can extend reviewer access for a short window.

Sophia Li: Heads-up I have 12 direct reports with substantive writeups. Is there a recommended reviewer split? I don't want any one reviewer overloaded during calibration.

Maya Chen: @Sophia Li — thanks. Two options: 1) Split into two reviewers per person (primary + secondary) in the tracker; or 2) ask people-ops to reassign some reviews. If you want us to rebalance, post counts in the tracker and we'll redistribute. Also consider setting "read-only" attachments to avoid edit conflicts.

HR Bot: Reminder: Performance form upload tool is available at https://intranet.redwood/reviews. Commands: `/upload [employee-id] [link]` to attach, `/exceptions add [employee-id] [reason]` to flag. See pinned message in #people-ops for full instructions.

Alex Gomez: Using the upload now. FYI the form accepts .pdf, .docx, and links. If anyone needs me to convert files to PDF, ping me.

Jordan Patel: Do self-assessments need to be attached to the same form or can they be emailed?

Maya Chen: Attach to the same form please — it keeps the packet together for reviewers and the calibration panel. If a contributor is unable to attach, contact people-ops and we'll accept emailed copies, but prefer the form.

Sophia Li: Where is the calibration rubric? I want to prep my leads with examples so we're aligned.

Maya Chen: Rubric is here: https://intranet.redwood/docs/calibration-rubric. Short version: competency bands + example behaviors + typical evidence. We'll circulate 3 anonymized calibration cases on Monday so the panel can practice. Observers are allowed (up to 2 per team) but please register them in the tracker.

Alex Gomez: Can reviewers see previous year ratings in the form? That helps context.

Maya Chen: Yes — previous-year ratings are visible in the packet unless the person opted out. Note: reviewers should avoid anchoring bias; rubric examples help with that.

Jordan Patel: I'll volunteer for Tue's panel if you still need people.

Sophia Li: Same, I can attend Tue 10–11.

Maya Chen: Awesome, @Jordan Patel and @Sophia Li — added you to the panel. Still need one more engineering rep (senior IC or manager). Anyone else?

HR Bot: New attachment: Maya Chen uploaded calibration prep deck (calibration_prep_v2.pdf).

Alex Gomez: Uploaded my attachments for ENG-Platform. All set from my side.

Maya Chen: Perfect — thank you all. Please keep the tracker updated and email people-ops if you hit friction. We plan a quick 15-min calibration sync Tue 9:45am PT to run through logistics before the panel. :thumbsup:
